Emotion Shader

Motion·by @raul_dronca·2026-08-26·inspora page·original post

What it is

Emotion Shader: a 3x3 grid of soft gradient orbs, one per emotion (Calm, Wonder, Joy, Desire, Passion, Fury, Obsession, Longing, Heavy/Void). Each orb is a blurry multi-stop radial swirl slowly churning inside a circular mask; label + muted sub-tags beside each.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-100%
Static grid composition; inside each orb the gradient swirl drifts and breathes (internal blobs rotate a few degrees and swell); hue stays per-emotion (ice blue, mint, gold, ember orange, crimson, blood red, wine, violet, slate).

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: "Emotion Shader" - a 3x3 grid of soft gradient orbs, one per emotion (Calm, Wonder, Joy, Desire, Passion, Fury, Obsession, Longing, Heavy/Void). Each orb is a blurry multi-stop radial swirl slowly churning inside a circular mask; label + muted sub-tags beside each.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Static 3x3 grid composition. Each cell: circular orb + label (emotion name, semibold) + muted sub-tags (zinc-500). Per-emotion hues: ice blue (Calm), mint (Wonder), gold (Joy), ember orange (Desire), crimson (Passion), blood red (Fury), wine (Obsession), violet (Longing), slate (Heavy/Void).

## Motion spec
Pattern: ambient per-orb churn.
- Inside each orb: internal blobs rotate a few degrees and swell on a 12-20s cycle, sine in-out drift; each orb on an offset phase so the grid never syncs.
- Blur stays constant; hue stays per-emotion - no hue cycling.
- Labels and grid: perfectly still.

## Calibration
- 12-20s cycles with offset phases: the grid should feel like nine separate weather systems.
- Rotation amplitude a few degrees only - churn, not spin.
- Heavy/Void (slate) moves slowest; Fury (blood red) fastest - tempo is part of the emotion mapping.

## Reduced motion
Each orb renders a static swirl frame.

## Don't miss
- The circular mask is hard-edged; softness lives inside the orb, not at its boundary.
- Gradients are multi-stop radials, never linear sweeps.
- Sub-tags are quiet (12px, zinc-500) - the orb speaks, the label names.
